counterfactual_missing_items: Negative for CD30, CD117, AFP, OCT4, calretinin, synaptophysin, Melan-A, ERG, CAIX, PAX8, TTF-1, and S100
decisive_items: Initial serum β-hCG: 691 IU/L (normal 0-5 IU/L), increased to 1860 IU/L on repeat
Immunostaining positive for AE1/AE3, CAM5.2, inhibin, β-hCG (strongly), Glypican-3 and PLAP (focally)
Poorly differentiated tumor composed of syncytial, intermediate in situ trophoblastic cells
response.rationale: R1 uniquely integrates the trophoblastic histology with markedly elevated and rising β-hCG and strong β-hCG immunostaining, yielding the specific diagnosis of choriocarcinoma. R3 is a broader restatement of the same trophoblastic identity without the β-hCG-specific confirmation. R4 only captures pulmonary nodules and family history, which are nonspecific metastatic/risk features. R2 describes the adrenal imaging appearance but is a radiologic finding, not the pathologic diagnosis, and lacks any raw support span.

rejected.why: Pulmonary nodules and family history are nonspecific and do not establish a tissue diagnosis; no raw span links them to trophoblastic tumor.
No raw support spans; imaging shows a hemorrhagic adrenal mass but this is a descriptive finding and not the most likely diagnosis given trophoblastic pathology and β-hCG.
